guidelines.title: Community Civility Guidelines
guidelines.subtitle: Guiding principles for maintaining an objective, constructive, and respectful academic review ecosystem at RateProfCuaBan.
guidelines.principle1Desc: Reviews should focus on pedagogy, lecture clarity, fairness of grading, assignment load, and student accessibility. Avoid emotional comments unrelated to the learning experience.
guidelines.principle2Title: 2. Zero Tolerance for Harassment & Personal Attacks
guidelines.principle2Desc: Hostile remarks, derogatory comments on physical appearance, ethnicity, religion, or gender identity are strictly prohibited.
guidelines.principle3Desc: Publishing personal telephone numbers, home addresses, family details, or private off-campus affairs will result in immediate content removal and permanent account bans.
guidelines.principle4Title: 4. Academic Honesty: One Review per Student
guidelines.principle4Desc: Each student may submit only one review per professor to safeguard against vote manipulation, coordinated brigading, or artificial inflation.
guidelines.moderationProcessDesc: The moderation board investigates all flagged reports. Faculty members and university administrators may request factual corrections or submit official responses through our verified support desk.

footer.mission: Open platform for discovering and rating university professors across 63 provinces in Vietnam. We build transparent educational bridges, helping students choose courses confidently while promoting positive academic excellence.
footer.disclaimerText: Reviews and ratings displayed on RateProfCuaBan are subjective evaluations shared by enrolled or former students. They do not reflect the official stance of any government authority or higher education institution. Defamatory, abusive, or privacy-violating comments are removed promptly in accordance with moderation guidelines.
